name: FreeRTOS Posix Demo
postCreateCommand: sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y build-essential wget unzip && wget -O FreeRTOS.zip https://github.com/FreeRTOS/FreeRTOS-Kernel/archive/refs/heads/main.zip && unzip -j FreeRTOS.zip 'FreeRTOS-Kernel-main/*.c' -d FreeRTOS && unzip -j FreeRTOS.zip 'FreeRTOS-Kernel-main/include/*.h' -d FreeRTOS/include && unzip -j FreeRTOS.zip 'FreeRTOS-Kernel-main/portable/ThirdParty/GCC/Posix/*.c' -d FreeRTOS/portable && unzip -j FreeRTOS.zip 'FreeRTOS-Kernel-main/portable/ThirdParty/GCC/Posix/*.h' -d FreeRTOS/portable && unzip -j FreeRTOS.zip 'FreeRTOS-Kernel-main/portable/MemMang/heap_3.c' -d FreeRTOS/portable && rm FreeRTOS.zip && chmod +x build.sh
